description: A shell script used for testing git cvsimport handling of branches and tags within a specific repository, including setup and multiple test cases for branch and tag structures.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a test repository for cvsimport testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with specified conditions and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares the branch tree against an expected branch or tag name.
